Alright, I figured that might be the case. In that case, I’d like to cancel the charger I just bought, since it goes with the tablet. Can you help me with that?
Yeah, I want to cancel it because I no longer need it. Please go ahead and cancel the charger.

Thanks for taking care of that. I also have an order with a boot and a kettle. I want to cancel the boot but keep the kettle. Can you help with that? If it’s not possible to cancel just the boot, then don’t do anything to that order.

Alright, thanks for letting me know. In that case, just leave that order as it is.

One more thing—I’d like to return a sneaker I bought. Can you help me with that?
Yes, it’s from that order, #W7449508. I want to return the sneaker and have the refund go back to my original gift card.
Yes, please go ahead and process the return for the sneaker.
That’s all I needed, thanks for your help.###STOP###
